column2: The administrations complete the transfers recorded in the German and Italian settlements. Northern federal territories join the North German Confederation, and the Venetian provinces pass to Italy. The Brazilian government confines its Bolivian claims to Acre, Abuna and Tarauaca.

On 5 February 1895 President Grover Cleveland awards the disputed Palmas territory to Brazil. The decision follows the case presented by Baron Rio Branco and establishes the frontier along the Peperi-Guacu and Santo Antonio rivers.
